# Accepted path references — read by check-paths.mjs, one per line:
#
#   <path>:<line>|<detector>|<reason>
#
# The reason is required and lives on the same line, so accepting a reference
# shows up in the diff that accepts it, with its justification beside it. An
# entry that matches nothing is reported as stale — the reference it excused has
# moved or gone, and the entry must go with it.
#
# This record sits beside the check rather than at the repository root because
# the root is the live home directory.
#
# Detectors: .github/scripts/check-paths.mjs
